criteria.title: Business Value Validation
criteria.description: PsychSync delivers measurable business value that justifies investment
criteria.success_threshold: ROI >200% within 12 months, key KPI improvements >20%
evidence_required: Key performance indicator baseline and target metrics

criteria.title: Strategic Alignment
criteria.description: Platform aligns with company strategic objectives and market positioning
criteria.success_threshold: 100% alignment with top 3 strategic priorities
blocking_issues: No clear path to market leadership

criteria.title: User Experience Excellence
criteria.description: Platform provides exceptional user experience across all user personas
criteria.success_threshold: User satisfaction >85%, task completion rate >90%
blocking_issues: Critical usability issues blocking core workflows
Negative user feedback from key personas

criteria.title: Feature Completeness
criteria.description: All required features are implemented and functional per specification
criteria.success_threshold: 100% of critical features, 90% of important features complete

criteria.title: System Performance
criteria.description: Platform meets or exceeds all performance requirements under load
criteria.success_threshold: Response time <2s, 99.9% uptime, supports 10x current load
blocking_issues: Response times >5 seconds for critical operations
Inability to scale to user requirements

criteria.title: Security Compliance
criteria.description: Platform meets all security requirements and compliance standards
criteria.success_threshold: Zero critical vulnerabilities, all compliance requirements met
blocking_issues: No security monitoring or incident response
test_data_points: Mean time to detect security incidents

criteria.title: Sales Process Integration
criteria.description: Platform integrates seamlessly with existing sales processes and tools
criteria.success_threshold: 100% sales workflow integration, <5% process disruption
blocking_issues: Major disruption to existing sales workflows

criteria.title: Marketing Campaign Optimization
criteria.description: Platform enhances marketing campaign effectiveness and team collaboration
criteria.success_threshold: Campaign ROI improvement >15%, team collaboration score >80%

criteria.title: Customer Success Enablement
criteria.description: Platform improves customer success team effectiveness and customer satisfaction
criteria.success_threshold: Customer satisfaction increase >10%, team efficiency >20%
blocking_issues: Negative customer feedback related to platform

criteria.title: HR Process Compliance
criteria.description: Platform maintains HR compliance and improves HR operational efficiency
criteria.success_threshold: 100% regulatory compliance, HR efficiency >25%

criteria.title: Operational Excellence
criteria.description: Platform enhances operational efficiency and business process optimization
criteria.success_threshold: Process efficiency improvement >30%, operational costs reduced >15%

criteria.title: Financial Viability
criteria.description: Platform delivers positive financial outcomes and acceptable cost structure
criteria.success_threshold: Positive ROI within 12 months, cost-benefit ratio >1.5

criteria.title: Legal & Regulatory Compliance
criteria.description: Platform meets all legal requirements and regulatory obligations
criteria.success_threshold: 100% compliance with applicable laws and regulations
evidence_required: Terms of service and privacy policy review
